title: A newly added technician appears after the existing unpinned technicians
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in to the build under test as a dispatcher whose role has Work Orders view and Work Orders create and edit (check: Settings > Roles & Permissions > open the role > on the Work Orders card, View and Create & Edit are both ticked. The Admin role has both).
  2. In the top bar, choose the location you test in (e.g. "Heavy Duty"). Every technician and work order below belongs to this location.
  3. Use a desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide (the display switcher only shows at 1024 px and wider).
  4. The location has these eligible technicians (examples): "ZZAUTOTEST Ben Bravo", "ZZAUTOTEST Cal Charlie", "ZZAUTOTEST Dan Delta".
    • A staff member counts as a technician when, in Settings > Staff > open the staff member > Edit Staff Member, they are Active, the Time Clock (clockable) setting is on, the role is neither Office nor Time Clock User, and they are enrolled at this location.
    • To add one: Settings > Staff > add a staff member with those settings (e.g. first name "ZZAUTOTEST Ana", last name "Alpha").
  5. Pin Dan in Board View (pin button in his column header, tooltip "Pin column").
  6. Reorder the unpinned technicians in Board View so they read Cal, Ben (drag Cal's header before Ben's).
  7. A staff member who is not yet a technician, e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST Ezra Echo" with the Time Clock setting off (Settings > Staff).
custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders from the top menu and click the All tab.
  2. Click Board View in the display switcher (the design tooltip reads "Board").
  3. Write down the column order (Unassigned, Dan pinned, Cal, Ben).
  4. Settings > Staff > add a new staff member "ZZAUTOTEST Aaron Able": Active, Time Clock on, role Technician, enrolled at this location. Save.
  5. Go back to Work Orders > All > Board View and read the column order.
  6. Settings > Staff > open ZZAUTOTEST Ezra Echo > Edit Staff Member > turn Time Clock on > save.
  7. Go back to Work Orders > All > Board View and read the column order.
  8. Click Tech View in the display switcher at the right of the toolbar (the design tooltip reads "By Lead Tech").
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 5: Aaron Able appears after the last unpinned technician: Unassigned, Dan (pinned), Cal, Ben, Aaron. He is not placed first by name, and your order is kept.
  • Step 7: Ezra Echo, who now counts as a technician, is added after Aaron: Unassigned, Dan, Cal, Ben, Aaron, Ezra.
  • Step 8: Tech View shows the technician groups in the same order.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10052 (Story 9, Drag to reorder work and technician groups/columns); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S9-R4, read 8 Oct 2026. Inline PRD comment by Sasha Grosman, 25 Sep 2026 (a new staff record that meets the technician criteria).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S9-R4: “When a staff member newly counts as a technician (Clockable, Active, role neither Office nor Time Clock User, and enrolled in the current location), for example when a new staff record is created, add them after the existing unpinned technicians.”
  • S9-R3: “Once anyone at the location has reordered a technician’s work orders, use that saved order instead of the initial sort. Once a user has reordered technician groups/columns, use their saved order instead of the initial technician sort.”
